Ilya (Legal): Will add a one-line statutory note and FAQ bullet under section 5.1 tonight.
AckBot: Auto-update: 10/48 managers confirmed, 1 session full. Use /rsvp in the invite.
Kevin (HR Ops): Scheduling: Tue 0800 UTC (EMEA), Wed 1600 UTC (US), Thu 2200 UTC (APAC)  15m each. Recordings posted.
Maya (People Ops): Hiring ops heads: grep active JDs for "parental" and "relocation" and tag @Kevin if numbers need updating. We'll hold reposts until JDs are aligned.
Sonia (EMEA Partner): Ill sweep EMEA reqs and tag owners; will sign off on DE once legal text is in.
